references.text: Direct parallel confirming Ishmael's genealogy in Chronicles.
Thematic parallel: A list of the descendants of Abraham's other son (Ishmael/Esau) showing God's blessing outside the chosen line of inheritance.
Thematic parallel: Esau's chiefs as a counterpart to Ishmael's sons, both demonstrating God's blessing outside the chosen line of inheritance.
Confirms Ishmael's identity as Abraham's son, which is the prerequisite for the list of his sons.
Direct parallel completing the list of Ishmael's sons in Chronicles.
